# Frozen companyfacts for the stale-annual pins

`tests/test_stale_annual.py` reads these. They track NO page and are never regenerated by
`scripts/build_companyfacts_fixture.py`: each one freezes a real filer in the shape that made the
alias resolver serve a years-old annual as current (STATE.md §5.0 row 11,
`docs/records/2026-10-27-annual-readers-withhold-a-stale-annual.md`).

Cut 2026-10-27 from the shared SEC cache, unmodified apart from the tag subset. Each keeps only
the aliases (`vinci.edgar.concepts.CONCEPT_ALIASES`) of the concepts its pins read, in the exact
companyfacts shape, `sort_keys` and `indent=1` like the tracking fixtures. DRH and GEF also keep
`vinci.edgar.net_debt.READ_TAGS`, so their ratio pins read a real net debt.

| file | filer (CIK) | fetched | concepts kept |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CLMB.json` | Climb Global Solutions (945983) | 2026-08-13 | operating cash flow, capex |
| `LODE.json` | Comstock Inc. (1120970) | 2026-08-13 | operating cash flow, capex |
| `ABCL.json` | AbCellera Biologics (1703057) | 2026-08-13 | operating income, D&A, operating cash flow, capex |
| `DRH.json` | DiamondRock Hospitality (1298946) | 2026-08-13 | operating income, D&A, net-debt lines |
| `SLG.json` | SL Green Realty (1040971) | 2026-08-13 | pre-tax income, operating cash flow, capex |
| `KALV.json` | KalVista Pharmaceuticals (1348911) | 2026-08-13 | revenue, operating income |
| `SCSC.json` | ScanSource (918965) | 2026-08-13 | operating cash flow |
| `PMT.json` | PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust (1464423) | 2026-09-23 | revenue |
| `GEF.json` | Greif, Inc. (43920) | 2026-09-17 | operating cash flow, net-debt lines |
| `NSSC.json` | Napco Security Technologies (69633) | 2026-09-23 | net income |

The filer's frontier (`filer_frontier`) is computed over every tag, so on a subset it is not the
filer's. Nothing pinned here depends on it: the alias walk reads it only to see that one exists,
and the check measures an annual against its own concept's aliases, which are all kept. Each
subset serves the alias the full blob serves (checked at cut time against the census).
